title: IFAN: An Explainability-Focused Interaction Framework for Humans and NLP Models
findings: The paper's framework, IFAN, was shown to effectively debias a hate speech classifier for a Jewish subgroup. By incorporating balanced human feedback through adapter layers, the model's precision score on the Jewish target group improved (e.g., from 0.95 to 0.97 for BERT, and F1 score from 0.48 to 0.53 for BLOOM) with minimal negative impact on its overall performance.
